# linkedin-cli

> A command-line tool and Python library that drives LinkedIn through a real,
> logged-in browser (Playwright) and LinkedIn's private Voyager API. It is meant
> to be used by LLM agents as a deterministic tool: every command emits a single
> JSON object on stdout with `--json`. Logs and errors go to
> stderr. There is no API key, no SaaS, and no database — it drives the user's own
> LinkedIn account on the user's own machine.

## How to use it

A session owner launches and binds one persistent browser; each command connects
to it. Select the session with `--session <name>` or `$LINKEDIN_CLI_SESSION`.
Add `--json` to any verb for the full result dict (the default prints a short
human summary). Credentials come from `$LINKEDIN_USERNAME` / `$LINKEDIN_PASSWORD`.
Commands targeting the same session are serialized by a local lock, so concurrent
agent invocations queue instead of driving the shared browser page at once.

```
linkedin-cli session open --session work   # start once; owns the browser, blocks
linkedin-cli login                         # authenticate the bound session
linkedin-cli session close                 # stop the session
```

An `<id>` argument is a public handle (e.g. `alice-smith`) or a profile URL.
A `<job>` is a LinkedIn job id or `/jobs/view/...` URL. A `<post>` is a LinkedIn
activity id, activity/share URN, or `/feed/update/...` URL. A comment can be
targeted by a full comment URL or by `<post> --comment-id <id>`. Commands are
independent and stateless; agents should thread explicit handles, job ids,
activity ids, comment ids, or notification indexes between steps.

A `<company-id>` is the numeric id in a company admin URL such as
`https://www.linkedin.com/company/112454418/admin/`. Use `page list` to discover
company pages the session can administer before calling company page commands.

## Commands and JSON results

- `login` → `{ "account": str, "self": { "public_identifier", "urn", "full_name" } }`
- `whoami` → `{ "self": { "public_identifier", "urn", "full_name" } }`
- `search <keywords> [--network first|second|third] [--page N]` →
  `{ "query", "page", "network": [..], "profiles": [ { "public_identifier", "url" } ] }`
- `profile <id> [--raw]` → full LinkedIn profile:
  `{ "url", "urn", "public_identifier", "full_name", "headline", "summary",
     "location_name", "positions": [..], "educations": [..], "connection_degree" }`
- `status <id>` → `{ "public_identifier", "state": "Connected"|"Pending"|"Qualified" }`
- `connect <id>` → `{ "public_identifier", "state": "Pending"|"Qualified" }` (no note)
- `message <id> --text <msg> [--attachment PATH ...]` →
  `{ "public_identifier", "sent": bool, "attachments": [PATH] }`
- `thread <id> [--limit N]` →
  `{ "public_identifier", "messages": [ { "sender", "text", "timestamp", "attachments": [ { "type": "file", "name", "media_type", "byte_size", "asset_urn", "url" } ] } ] }`
- `notifications [--limit N]` →
  `{ "notifications": [ { "unread", "actor", "text", "url", "activity_id", "comment_id", "links" } ] }`
- `notifications reply --index N --text <msg>` →
  `{ "index", "notification", "activity_id", "comment_id", "replied": bool, "text" }`
- `notifications react --index N [--reaction like|celebrate|support|love|insightful|funny]` →
  `{ "index", "notification", "activity_id", "comment_id"?, "reaction", "reacted": bool }`
- `jobs search <keywords> [--location <loc>] [--page N] [--easy-apply] [--remote] [--date-posted past-24h|past-week|past-month] [--job-type full-time|part-time|contract|temporary|internship]` →
  `{ "query", "location", "page", "filters", "jobs": [ { "job_id", "url", "title", "company", "location", "listed" } ] }`
- `jobs saved [--page N]` →
  `{ "page", "jobs": [ { "job_id", "url", "title", "company", "location", "listed" } ] }`
- `jobs show <job>` →
  `{ "job_id", "url", "title", "company", "location", "listed", "applicants", "workplace", "employment_type", "saved", "apply_method", "apply_url", "external_url", "ats", "description" }`
- `jobs save <job>` → `{ "job_id", "url", "saved": bool, "changed": bool }`
- `jobs unsave <job>` → `{ "job_id", "url", "saved": bool, "changed": bool }`
- `jobs apply <job> [--submit]` →
  `{ "job_id", "url", "method": "external"|"easy_apply"|null, "submitted": bool, "manual": bool, "apply_url", "external_url", "ats", ... }`
- `posts profile <id> [--page N] [--limit N]` →
  `{ "public_identifier", "page", "posts": [ { "activity_id", "url", "author", "content", "engagement" } ] }`
- `posts show <post>` →
  `{ "activity_id", "url", "author", "content", "engagement" }`
- `posts engagement <post>` →
  `{ "activity_id", "url", "author", "content", "engagement", "comments" }`
- `posts comments <post> [--limit N]` →
  `{ "activity_id", "url", "comments": [ { "comment_id", "author", "profile_url", "text", "reactions" } ] }`
- `posts create --text <text> [--image PATH] [--document PATH] [--poll-option O ...]` →
  `{ "posted": bool, "text", "images", "documents", "poll" }`
- `posts draft --text <text>` → `{ "drafted": bool, "text" }`
- `posts schedule --text <text> --at YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM` →
  `{ "scheduled": bool, "scheduled_at", "text" }`
- `posts scheduled` →
  `{ "scheduled_posts": [ { "index", "activity_id", "scheduled_at", "scheduled_label", "content" } ] }`
- `posts cancel <index>` →
  `{ "cancelled": bool, "index", "activity_id", "scheduled_at", "scheduled_label", "content" }`
- `posts delete <post>` → `{ "deleted": bool, "activity_id", "url" }`
- `posts react <post> [--reaction like|celebrate|support|love|insightful|funny]` →
  `{ "activity_id", "url", "reaction", "reacted": bool }`
- `posts comment-reply <post> --comment-id C [--author A] --text <text>` →
  `{ "activity_id", "comment_id", "author", "replied": bool, "text" }`
- `posts comment-react <post> --comment-id C [--author A] [--reaction like|celebrate|support|love|insightful|funny]` →
  `{ "activity_id", "comment_id", "author", "reaction", "reacted": bool }`
- `page list` →
  `{ "pages": [ { "company_id", "name", "admin_url" } ] }`
- `page posts <company-id> [--limit N]` →
  `{ "company_id", "tab": "published", "posts": [ { "activity_id", "url", "content", "engagement" } ] }`
- `page post <company-id> <post>` →
  `{ "activity_id", "url", "author", "content", "engagement" }`
- `page post-create <company-id> --text <text> [--image PATH] [--document PATH] [--poll-option O ...]` →
  `{ "company_id", "posted": bool, "text", "images", "documents", "poll", "uploaded_images", "uploaded_documents" }`
- `page post-schedule <company-id> --text <text> --at YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM` →
  `{ "company_id", "scheduled": bool, "scheduled_at", "text" }`
- `page post-scheduled <company-id>` →
  `{ "company_id", "scheduled_posts": [ { "index", "activity_id", "scheduled_at", "scheduled_label", "content" } ] }`
- `page post-cancel <company-id> <index>` →
  `{ "company_id", "cancelled": bool, "index", "activity_id", "scheduled_at", "scheduled_label", "content" }`
- `page post-delete <company-id> <post>` →
  `{ "company_id", "activity_id", "deleted": bool }`
- `page inbox <company-id> [--limit N]` →
  `{ "company_id", "threads": [ { "thread_id", "url", "summary" } ] }`
- `page thread <company-id> <thread-id-or-url> [--limit N]` →
  `{ "company_id", "thread_id", "messages": [ { "sender", "timestamp", "text", "attachments": [ { "type": "file", "name", "size", "url", "downloadable" } ] } ] }`
- `page reply <company-id> <thread-id-or-url> --text <text> [--attachment PATH ...]` →
  `{ "company_id", "thread_id", "sent": bool, "text", "attachments": [PATH], "attached": bool }`

Messaging notes: `--attachment` is repeatable. Personal `thread` reads messages
through Voyager and returns structured file attachments from `renderContent`.
Company page inbox reads are DOM-based: `page inbox` and `page thread` scroll to
load more visible threads/messages up to `--limit`, and `page thread` returns
structured file attachments from the admin inbox attachment rows. Attachment URLs
are LinkedIn signed URLs and may expire.

Read-only commands: `whoami`, `search`, `profile`, `status`, `thread`,
`notifications`, `jobs search`, `jobs saved`, `jobs show`, `posts profile`,
`posts show`, `posts engagement`, `posts comments`, `posts scheduled`, `page list`, `page posts`,
`page post`, `page post-scheduled`, `page inbox`, `page thread`.

Commands that change LinkedIn state: `connect`, `message`, `jobs save`,
`jobs unsave`, `jobs apply --submit`, `notifications reply`, `notifications react`,
`posts create`, `posts draft`, `posts schedule`, `posts cancel`, `posts delete`, `posts react`,
`posts comment-reply`, `posts comment-react`, `page post-create`,
`page post-schedule`, `page post-cancel`, `page post-delete`, `page reply`.

## Errors

On failure: non-zero exit and a line on stderr `error: <type>: <message>`.
Stable `type` values to branch on: `checkpoint_challenge`, `authentication`,
`profile_inaccessible`, `skip_profile`, `connection_limit`.

## Typical agent loop

People: search → for each handle: profile and/or status → message and/or thread.
Engagement: notifications → reply/react by notification index, or posts comments →
posts comment-reply/comment-react when a comment id is available.
Company pages: page list → choose company_id → page posts/page post/page post-scheduled
for read-only inspection; page post-create/page post-schedule/page post-cancel/page
post-delete for page content management; page inbox/page thread/page reply for company page inbox workflows.

- Per-verb help: `linkedin-cli <verb> --help`
